name: collision_divergent_payload
description: Two observations sharing the dedup key (tars, d, 0, 0) with DIVERGENT variants: T at 1.0 then F at 0.5. The key-collision fold resolves them to a single C at the minimum weight (0.5) — a source contradicting itself within one observation slot is irreconcilable evidence, not a race to be won. The C is the resolved BASE observation (source tars), not a demerzel-merge synthesis, so contradictions_count is 0. Input order must not matter: swapping the two observations yields byte-identical output. Pins the resolve_key_versions fold from hex-merge.md (2026-07-20, GuitarAlchemist/hari#27).
